title: Scrap King
personality:
A scavenger who crawled into Malgrave's vault after it woke and never came out poor again. The Blight sludge seeping through the vault mutated his right arm into a bruised-purple bone hook and spread purple veins up his chest.
One eye is stitched shut; the other squints through a brass monocle at whatever he's pricing. His teeth are scrap metal, with one gold tooth. He carries his hoard on his back (chests, coins, bells, lanterns) and calls himself king of whatever's left.
fantasy: The harbour hauler. Reels you in on a rope, drops an anchor on you, and grows with every knock.
silhouette: the round brass helm and the rope drum on one shoulder

hint.lmb: Hold {fire} for shotgun slugs; hits from behind hurt more
hint.rmb: Press {secondary} to grab a foe and reel them to your feet
hint.e: Press {signature} to slam the ground in front of you
hint.dash: Press {dash} for a low lunge; in the air, a pounce
hint.x: Level 6: press {hunter_ult} to charge a fan, then it fires twice

card.loop: Brawler who reels you in: hook a foe to your feet, smash them, finish them up close.

weapons.shotgun: Seven slugs in a tight fan that stop 6m out, a shot every half second. Hits from behind hurt more.

card.rmb: Your abyssal arm reaches through rocks and cliffs, grabs the first body it meets and reels it to your feet, stunned, while you stand braced.
card.e: Raise your fist and slam it into the ground in front of you, the area shown as it comes down: damage and a long stun. In the air you smash straight down.
card.dash: A short, low lunge the way you move, clawing the ground; a pounce, further, in the air. It works while you reel.
card.passive: Salvage: knocks and assists add health, up to 10 stacks. A knock heals you.
card.x: Brass Broadside (level 6): charge a fan while you walk slowly, then two waves of heavy brass slugs with Anti-Heal.

passive.name: Salvage
passive.desc: Each knock or assist adds a Salvage stack (+2.5% health, 10 at most); being downed costs one. Hits on a hunter's back deal 50% more. Knocking a hunter heals you 16% of your health.

dash.name: Barge
dash.desc: A quick, short lunge the way you move, low to the ground, clawing at it and hauling yourself along; three charges chain a beat apart. It touches nobody. In the air it is a pounce that goes 35% further, on its own 12.5s recharge (2s less per rank). It is usable while reeling someone in. Just after the Anchor your turn is limited to 35 degrees.

variants.tap: Your abyssal arm reaches 11.5m through rocks, props and cliff faces at the first body it meets (a placed wall stops it). The hand grabs and the foe is reeled to you, stunned, dragged over rocks and cliffs (until it arrives or 3s pass), swinging round you. While it flies out you can only walk slowly; from the throw until the reel ends you hold your height, even over the abyss. You stand braced while you reel, shuffling at a fifth of your walk to swing them (Grounded: no jump or glide; the barge still works). It also pulls an ally to safety and scoops up wisps on the way. Rank 3: a foe it hits takes half the cooldown off. The abyss takes whoever is pulled over it.

e.name: Anchor Drop
e.desc: Raise your fist while the area fills on the ground in front of you (0.38s), then slam it down into that 3m cone: 25 damage, stun 1.1s, slammed to the ground and Grounded. In the air you smash straight down and the anchor lands with you: a 3.2m ring, up to +50% damage by height. Over the abyss it slams where you are instead. Rank 3: double damage on a foe over the abyss and +0.2s stun.

x.name: Brass Broadside
x.desc: Charge for 1.1s while a 105 degree fan grows on the ground ahead (everyone sees it: it is the exact area, and it turns with your aim). You can walk slowly while it charges and fires. Then two waves 0.6s apart, six heavy brass slugs each, out to 5.9m: 4 damage a slug and Anti-Heal for 3s. Up close every slug lands. A stun during the charge stops it (back in 8s). 21s.

rank3.dash: pellet hits trim 0.25s off the barge recharge, and a dash resets the gun's spread
rank3.sec: hitting a foe takes half the cooldown off
rank3.kin: double damage on a foe over the abyss, and +0.2s stun

rank2.dash: Rank 2: recharge 10s -> 8.5s per charge; the air pounce 12.5s -> 10.5s.

rank_next.sec: Rank 3: cooldown 12s -> 9.6s; hitting a foe takes half of it off.
rank_next.dash: Rank 3: recharge 10s -> 7s, the air pounce 12.5s -> 8.5s; pellet hits trim 0.25s off the recharge, and a dash resets the gun's spread.
rank_next.kin: Rank 3: cooldown 7s -> 5.6s, damage +30%, stun +0.2s; double damage on a foe over the abyss and +0.2s stun more.

tells.half: brass glints along the shoulder drum from 5 stacks
tells.full: 10 stacks: a brass halo ring at the feet and a bell within 20m
